label: kizuna_ecology_e_01
text: Ah! Hello, hello, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_02
text: What?! Are you telling me you’ve already\nregistered 400 species of Pokémon to your\r\nPokédex?![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_03
text: Wow! WOW! You did it! You completed the\nPokédex! That’s amazing! REALLY amazing![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_04
text: Research on the Pokémon of the Paldea region\nis moving ahead like never before! And it’s all\r\nthanks to you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_05
text:
You know, I visited this strange shop the other
day and happened to pick up a little something...\c
Might not seem like much to get a secondhand
gift, but here! From me to you![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_06
text: I wish I could give you something a bit better for\nyour efforts...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_01
text: Now what’s all this commotion about, I wonder?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_07
text: Ah! Director Clavell! This student of mine\nCOMPLETED their Pokédex![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_02
text: Upon my word![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_03
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]What a marvelous accomplishment,\nM[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_08
text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe really surprised me too, pulling off a feat\nlike this.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_04
text: Well, Mr. Jacq’s delight clearly shows how\ncommendable your work has been.\c\nPlease, allow me to reward you with a small gift.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_05
text:
Students who achieve great feats such as this
deserve to be recognized for their hard work.\c
This congratulatory message, penned by the
company that certifies Pokédex completion,
is for you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_06
text: I reconfigured your Pokédex app so that you may\nview your diploma there anytime you like.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_09
text: Programming is another of Director Clavell’s\nskills, you know.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_10
text: But anyway, you sure did great with the Pokédex,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_11
text: If completing the Pokédex was one of the\ntreasures you were after, then I’d say you’ve had\r\na resounding success on your Treasure Hunt![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_07
text: Quite right, Mr. Jacq. A fitting comment indeed.\nIf rather surprising coming from you.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_12
text: Hehe... Well, I am h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser homeroom teacher, after\nall. Got to act like it from time to time, I guess.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_13
text: You may have completed your Pokédex, but\nthere is still plenty of adventure to be had![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_14
text: I hope you’ll keep looking for new Pokémon to\nbefriend here in Paldea![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: kizuna_ecology_e_head_08
text: I very much look forward to watching over your\ncontinued progress as well.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
